title: Declarations to be made on every package
source_text: Every package is required to bear the prescribed declarations. These include applicable declarations relating to the manufacturer/packer/importer, commodity, net quantity, retail sale price and consumer-related information, subject to the specific requirements and exemptions in the rules.

title: Principal display panel — its area, size and letter etc.
source_text: This rule specifies requirements concerning the principal display panel, including its area, size and the manner in which prescribed declarations are displayed.

title: Declaration where to appear
source_text: This rule specifies where the required declarations are to appear on the package.

title: Manner in which declaration shall be made
source_text: This rule specifies the manner in which declarations must be made, including requirements concerning visibility, legibility and the prescribed presentation of declarations.

title: Declaration of name and address of the manufacturer, etc.
source_text: This rule specifies requirements for declaring the name and address of the manufacturer, packer and/or importer, as applicable.

title: Declaration of name and address of the manufacturer, etc.
source_text: This rule specifies requirements for declaring the name and address of the manufacturer, packer and/or importer, as applicable.

title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity
source_text: This rule contains general requirements for declaring the quantity of the commodity in the package.

title: Manner in which declaration of quantity shall be made
source_text: This rule specifies the manner and form in which the quantity declaration is to be made.

title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
source_text: This rule specifies the units in which declarations of weight, measure or number are to be expressed.
